Must try indian food in ninh binh
Jan 2025 • Friends
Aroma Indian Restaurant in Ninh Binh is a great spot for delicious Indian food! 🍛🇮🇳 The flavors are authentic, with a good variety of dishes, including vegetarian options. , chicken biryani , chicken tika masala and garlic naan were especially tasty! 😋🔥

The atmosphere is cozy, and the staff is friendly and attentive. Service is quick, and the food is freshly prepared. If you're craving Indian cuisine while in Ninh Binh, this place is definitely worth a visit! Highly recommended.
